title: MZ Is there a plugin out there which gives the Rpg Maker XP Battlers in Rpg Maker MZ?

posts.author: MoonWolfV
posts.body:
Just wondering if there's a plugin which replaces the face graphics in battles with battler graphics like how Rpg Maker XP did it? I'm pretty much trying to use the XP graphics and style with Rpg Maker MZ.
I do own Rpg Maker XP (from Steam) by the way.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Have you checked this?
Simple XP Style Battle & Result
